plugins.name: claudeTalk
plugins.description: Voice for Claude Code on Windows: talk mode where Claude speaks to you (Edge neural voices, native and instant) with a distinct voice per parallel session, local Whisper dictation (native, light, any GPU or CPU), hands-free "Oye Claude" (or your own wake phrase) that types into your last Claude session from any app, games included, with any terminal, and a liquid glass overlay that confirms each send.
